sets.title: High token overlap, different semantics - FP bait only
sets.description: Three carrier files share ≥60% token overlap with each other, but compute different results. A token-based detector WOULD pair them because they look similar at the token level, but semantic analysis reveals they perform different computations. This measures the false-positive rate when threshold is low. L0-style: no actual duplication present.
sets.notes: CP-10: High token overlap with different semantics. Token tools WOULD pair these (token_based:true) but semantic analysis shows different computation - making them false positives. The point is measuring FP rate when threshold is low.

distractors.reason: Near-miss distractor: same invoice calculation vocabulary (lineItems/tax/discount/total) but computes a different result - adds premium shipping fee instead of conditional shipping
